prompt: What is the best invoicing software for freelancers?

raw.prompt: What is the best invoicing software for freelancers?
raw.answer_text: For most freelancers, I’d recommend Zoho Invoice if you want free software, or FreshBooks if you want a more complete paid solution. You probably don’t need expensive accounting software just to create invoices, track payments, and remind clients when bills are overdue. The best choice depends on whether you bill by the hour, work with recurring clients, need bookkeeping, or simply want to get paid without a monthly subscription. Guides Reviews +1 The 5 best invoicing tools for freelancers 1. Zoho Invoice Best free option $0/month Create professional invoices, automate payment reminders, track billable hours, manage expenses, and send recurring invoices. Excellent value without a subscription. Zoho Invoice +1 Best for: solo freelancers and consultants. Visit Zoho Invoice 2. FreshBooks From $23/month at standard Lite pricing A polished, easy-to-use option with time tracking, expense management, estimates, online payments, and accounting reports. The Lite plan limits you to five billable clients. FreshBooks +1 Best for: service providers who bill by the hour or project. Visit FreshBooks 3. Wave Free plan; Pro $19/month Combines invoicing with basic bookkeeping. The free plan supports unlimited invoices and estimates, while Pro adds bank transaction imports and automated late-payment reminders. Payment processing costs extra. Wave Financial +1 Best for: US-based freelancers who want simple bookkeeping too. Visit Wave 4. Bonsai Paid plans; pricing varies by billing term Brings proposals, contracts, client management, project tracking, and invoicing into one workflow. Best for: freelancers who want to manage the client relationship from proposal to payment. Visit Bonsai 5. Invoice Ninja Free plan; paid upgrades available Offers invoice customization, recurring billing, client portals, and payment integrations. It is also worth considering if you prefer open-source software or self-hosting. Best for: technically minded freelancers who want flexibility. Visit Invoice Ninja Quick comparison Software Free plan Time tracking Bookkeeping Zoho Invoice Yes Yes Basic expense tracking FreshBooks Trial only Yes Yes Wave Yes No Yes Bonsai No Yes Business management features Invoice Ninja Yes, with limits Yes Limited Which one should you choose? Spend nothing: Zoho Invoice is my first choice for straightforward invoicing. Bill hourly: FreshBooks makes it easier to connect your time and expenses to your invoices. Handle invoices and books together: Wave is a strong budget-friendly choice in the US. Manage contracts and proposals: Bonsai is worth considering. Remember to compare payment-processing fees as well as subscription costs. If clients pay by card, those fees can add up quickly. Let me narrow it down for you 1. What is your monthly software budget? Free only $1–$25 per month $25+ per month for more features 2. How do you charge clients? By the hour Per project or fixed fee Recurring monthly retainers Products or one-off services 3. What do you need most? Just invoices and payment reminders Online payments and recurring billing Bookkeeping and tax-time reports An all-in-one freelance business tool Find my best fit
